entities.name: Eric IV of Denmark
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eric IV, also known as Eric Ploughpenny or Eric Plowpenny, was King of Denmark from 1241 until his death in 1250. His reign was marked by conflict and civil wars against his brothers.
